'''M3-OB''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] companion of the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Zale Barrows]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] M3-OB was with Barrows on the surface when the rioting started and Barrows decided to stay to ensure the most dangerous prisoners do not escape. Pursued by Zale's old nemesis [[Skadge]] and a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] hired by [[Darth Tormen]], Barrows and M3-OB tried to escape by separating themselves behind a force field. However, the hunter disabled the generators maintaining the field and Barrows was forced to flee, leaving M3-OB behind to be destroyed by Skadge. The [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] and the Hunter were later able to retrieve Barrows' destination from M3-OB's databanks.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
M3-OB appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
